name: Red Guardian

abilityDetails.Perfect Block: Bloklarken gelen tüm hasarı sıfıra indirir.
abilityDetails.Trauma: Alınan vuruşlar, yakın zamanda verilen hasarın bir kısmını ek fiziksel hasar patlaması olarak verdirir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Fragility: Gelen saldırıların kritik hasar oranını artırır ve blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır.

howToPlay: Red Guardian için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Science sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Enhanced Combat Durability
Maximum Durability for the Ablative Shield is increased by +1 for every 40 signature levels obtained. Max increase of +5.
Heavy and Special attacks gain +[731.01 - 1,841.1] Critical Rating for each unique Debuff on the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Ablative Shield
content: Red Guardian is immune to Buffs. Whenever a Buff is prevented by immunity he gains +1 Durability for his Ablative Shield instead.
The Ablative Shield starts each fight at 9 Durability and can stack up to a max of 10. Each blocked hit removes 1 Durability. Well-Timed Blocks do not remove Durability.
Each Stack of Durability increases Perfect Block chance by 5%. Perfect Blocks reduce incoming damage to 0.
While the Shield is intact, Red Guardian can block Heavy and Unblockable Attacks and gains [1,833.33] Block Proficiency.
Blocking a Heavy or Unblockable Attack reduces Shield Durability to 0, however all hits of the incoming Attack can be blocked.
When reaching 0 Durability the Shield is Fractured, entering cooldown for 18 second(s). When cooldown ends, the Shield is repaired at 7 Durability.

abilitySections.title: On Fracture
content: Carbonadium shards from the Ablative Shield burst onto the Opponent, inflicting a Stun Debuff for 1.9 seconds.
Inflict a non-stacking Trauma Debuff for 12 seconds, Trauma causes each hit to deal an additional 100% of the damage recently dealt as burst Physical Damage.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Gain +[2,957.5] Attack Rating for each unique Debuff on the Opponent.
Refresh all Slow, Fragility and Trauma Debuffs on the Opponent.
While the Ablative Shield is on cooldown, charging a Heavy Attack grants Red Guardian a 0.8 second Unstoppable Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation inflict a non-stacking Slow Debuff for 16 seconds.
While the Opponent is suffering from Slow, Red Guardian's Combat Power Rate is increased by 25%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation if the Ablative Shield was intact, gain +[3,785.6] Attack Rating throughout this Special.

If this Attack strikes the Opponent the Ablative Shield is Fractured, removing all Durability. Each stack of Durability removed grants an additional +[1,419.6] Attack Rating to each hit of this attack.
During this attack any Debuffs inflicted last 100% longer.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If the Ablative Shield is active, it's Durability is set to max. If the Ablative Shield is Fractured its cooldown ends immediately.
100% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff for 1.9 seconds.
100% chance to inflict a 30 second Fragility Debuff. Attacking a Fragile Opponent grants +[1,546.88] Critical Damage Rating and reduces Block Proficiency by 50%.
